parts.how: Tall double-wall insulated cylinder; matte black exterior; fixed mouth diameter as in refs.
Full metal/plastic screw-off lid on the threaded bottle mouth; remove entire lid to drink or pour.
Separate plastic flip/hinge pour lid that sits on its own seat — not a spout molded onto the screw threads.

forbid: do not invent a plastic pour spout or flip lid opening directly on the metal screw threads
do not mix screw mouth and flip spout into a hybrid that does not exist on the real product
do not redesign the mouth diameter or add a straw/button not in the references
do not shorten or restyle the body from a part-detail (lid-only) crop

no third-party logos, wordmarks, or brand-identifiable devices (MacBook, iPhone, Apple logo, Nike swoosh, Starbucks cup mark, Amazon smile, Google/Microsoft hardware logos) unless the advertised SKU is that brand or the user explicitly approved it
immutable.colors: Matte black body; lid finish as in refs; no chrome redesign.
immutable.proportions: Tall slim bottle; cup/lid height similar to refs; keep silhouette.

notes: If a shot needs 'steam from open lid', specify which parts[].id is open; never invent a third closure mechanism. Part-detail refs (product-flip.jpg etc.) correct ONLY that part — keep body height/silhouette/scene from the hero ref (or approved composition keyframe); unify the part onto the original product.
